text:
sqlpipe moves data from Postgres to S3 through three stages:

- reader: streams rows from Postgres in batches
- converter: turns each batch into a Parquet row group
- uploader: writes the Parquet file to S3 as a multipart object

The three stages run at the same time. The reader sends each batch to the converter. The converter sends each row group to the uploader. No stage waits for the full data set.

This pipeline keeps memory use low, because sqlpipe never holds a full table in memory.

If a part upload fails, the uploader retries that part. Retries happen at the part level, not at the file level.
